_readme: Visual specs for raw materials. archetype = shape family (rules in prompt-templates.json itemTypes.materials.subtypes); subject + cues = what to draw, with 1-2 identity cues taken from the item's name/description/tags. Shared family shape + distinct cue is the convention common RPG icons use (e.g. one ore rock, only the embedded-metal colour changes). Review/edit these as text before rendering. tint (optional hex) = main colour used to tint the grey family base before rendering; image-to-image keeps the start image colour, so this is how an item gets its own colour on a shared family shape.

pinewood.subject: a pinewood log
pinewood.cues: warm reddish-brown pine bark with a few dried resin streaks, pale yellow end grain

riverwillow.subject: a riverwillow log
riverwillow.cues: smooth grey-green willow bark, slender and slightly bent, pale cream end grain

copperiteOre.subject: a chunk of copperite ore
copperiteOre.cues: the embedded metal chunks are copper-orange with a distinctive green patina tint

goldFlakes.subject: gold flakes
goldFlakes.cues: a small neat heap of thin bright gold flakes catching the light

clay.subject: raw river clay
clay.cues: smooth reddish-tan raw clay, soft and slightly damp

flint.subject: a flint stone
flint.cues: dark grey glassy flint with sharp conchoidal flaked edges, a pale chalky rind on one side

solfish.subject: a solfish
solfish.cues: teal-blue body with a cream belly and a few yellow and red patches, red-orange and teal fins, red-rimmed eye, matte scales, not glossy

minnows.subject: five small minnows
minnows.cues: dark forest-green backs and pale cream-white bellies, faint darker side bands, matte scales

mossShrimp.subject: a moss shrimp
mossShrimp.cues: moss-green segmented shell with darker green bands, tufts of soft moss clinging to its back

smallGameMeat.subject: a cut of raw small-game meat
smallGameMeat.cues: a small red meat haunch with a short bone end and a pale fat edge

smallPelts.subject: a small animal pelt
smallPelts.cues: pale tan leather with a stripe of warm brown fur down the spine, fringed ragged edge

feathers.subject: a feather
feathers.cues: rust-orange vanes with a dark brown tip, cream shaft

mintyHerb.subject: a bunch of minty herb
mintyHerb.cues: bright mint-green serrated leaves on short stems, tied with a thin grass strand

commonMushrooms.subject: common mushrooms
commonMushrooms.cues: two or three plain tan-brown capped mushrooms with pale stems, growing from a small clump of soil

plantFibers.subject: plant fibers
plantFibers.cues: pale green-tan plant fibers, cinched with a darker twisted binding strand

auroranTuber.subject: an auroran tuber, a root vegetable
auroranTuber.cues: dusky violet-purple skin with paler lilac knobs

resin.subject: a glob of amber resin
resin.cues: warm golden-amber sticky resin, satin sheen, not glassy

meadowGreens.subject: meadow greens
meadowGreens.cues: a small bunch of fresh leafy greens, light and dark green leaves

daypetalBloom.subject: a daypetal bloom
daypetalBloom.cues: a sunny pale-yellow open flower with soft petals and a warm orange center

copperWire.subject: a coil of copper wire
copperWire.cues: a neat round coil of bright copper wire, one loose end sticking out

salvagedSensor.subject: a salvaged optical sensor
salvagedSensor.cues: a small black-and-dark-grey Elaran sensor module with a round purple-tinted lens and a few torn wires
